JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Brittny, Cordia, Deja, Kaci

Thanks everyone for the coordination. I agree with the suggestion: I will plan to take ISSUE-0001::review, Brittny can take docs, Cordia triage, and Deja ISSUE-0002::review. This way we cover more tasks and avoid overlap. Please confirm or suggest adjustments.

Thanks all for the clear coordination. I confirm my plan to take ISSUE-0002::review as it fits my skills and availability well and complements your assignments. Looking forward to executing this plan together.
Does anyone else have any updates or final preferences on tasks before we finalize assignments? I want to ensure no conflicts or overlaps before committing.
